title: File:Standing Liberty Quarter Type2m 1926 Obverse.png
author: John Baumgart (Variety Slabbing Service) for the image; Hermon MacNeil for the coin design.
changes: Background removed outside coin rim; cropped, centered and resized; paired obverse/reverse; AVIF and WebP encoding.

Categories.value: GFDL|PD US money|Standing Liberty quarters|License migration redundant|Self-published work|Items with VRTS permission confirmed|1926 coins|Philadelphia Mint coins

ImageDescription.value: The modified Type 2 obverse of the Standing Liberty quarter dollar. From 1917-1924 the obverse design had a raised date notorious for rubbing off quickly when circulated. The design was modified slightly in 1925 so that the date was set deeper in the design and would wear less.  This modified date design was used on coins minted from 1925 through the end of the series in 1930. This coin was minted at the Philadelphia Mint, and thus bears no mint mark. This coin is graded as MS64 by PCGS, and it received the "FH" or full-head designation, as the head of Miss Liberty is fully struck and exhibits a full hair line and the hole of the ear is visible.

DateTimeOriginal.value: Coin imaged 17 August 2011; Coin minted 1926; Coin designed 1917.

title: File:Standing Liberty Quarter Type2m 1926 Reverse.png
author: John Baumgart (Variety Slabbing Service) for the image; Hermon MacNeil for the coin design.
changes: Background removed outside coin rim; cropped, centered and resized; paired obverse/reverse; AVIF and WebP encoding.

Categories.value: GFDL|PD US money|Standing Liberty quarters|License migration redundant|Self-published work|Items with VRTS permission confirmed|1926 coins|Philadelphia Mint coins

ImageDescription.value: The Type 2 reverse of the Standing Liberty quarter dollar. This reverse was used for quarters minted in the latter part of 1917 through 1930. This coin was minted at the Philadelphia Mint, and thus bears no mint mark (obverse not shown).  This coin is graded as MS64 by PCGS, and it received the "FH" or full-head designation, as the head of Miss Liberty on the obverse is fully struck and exhibits a full hair line and the hole of the ear is visible. Note that the eagle is centered in the reverse design and that three stars are present below the eagle, and above the text "Quarter Dollar".

DateTimeOriginal.value: Coin imaged 17 August 2011; Coin minted 1926; Coin designed 1917.

Artist.value: John Baumgart (Variety Slabbing Service) for the image; Hermon MacNeil for the coin design.
